scope: Local development prototype only; not pushed or deployed.
demo: Three separate editable assets: Chrome text, Glass image, Ripple video. Existing holiday assets are not changed.

engine.effects: Locally authored WGSL using the public custom-component API; no proprietary presets.

controls: Existing Design inspector: Effect dropdown, intensity, animated switch, speed. Select a layer to affect it; deselect to affect the whole canvas.
persistence: Native layer content and geometry retained; bounded effect settings survive save/reopen and editable-source serialization. Undo remains available.
playback: Existing playback timeline. Four-second hold per asset with an animated effect; shared sampled clock in video export.

verification.tests: 40 targeted tests passed; 6 shader tests rerun after final normal smoothing.
verification.browser: Chrome: edit native text, pause/resume effect, save/reopen, whole canvas effect, undo, playback, PNG and MP4 export.
verification.production: Shader engine and effect UI are excluded by import.meta.env.DEV.

limits: WebGPU-capable browser required; original layer remains visible if unavailable.
Effect texture resolution capped at 1440px on the long edge in this prototype.
Whole-canvas animated compositing targets native 2D layers; perspective/3D compositions need separate validation.
PNG is a static sample at time zero.

refinement.request: Replace faceted Chrome with the softer supplied blue/pink reference; repair native text shortcuts and use a simple placeholder without slash commands.
refinement.chrome: Smooth rolled edge from silhouette distance; broad blue/lavender/pink environment normalized to the visible glyph bounds. Demo uses one large editable more specimen.
refinement.text: Cmd/Ctrl+B, I, U target the native character selection or selected text layers; caret-only formatting updates the text block. Legacy weight precedence is retained until inline formatting is used.
refinement.placeholder: Type something…; editor-only, empty text only. Slash is ordinary typed content on the canvas.
refinement.verification: Build passed, 26 targeted tests passed; browser verified block and character formatting, toggle back, native undo/redo, saved state, fresh text insertion and PNG without placeholder.
